mode: post-hoc frozen-prediction analysis; no new training
predictions: Existing 0.5-threshold binary masks; no ensemble and no threshold changes
fov: PIL RGB bilinear-resize 512, then PIL grayscale > 5/255
radius: Ground-truth EDT radius <=1.5 pixels, not diameter

bootstrap.resampling: Crossed seed and image, independently; paired arms
bootstrap.multiplicity: Bonferroni intervals for four structural comparisons; still exploratory post-hoc
bootstrap.additional: 95% image-only intervals after seed averaging; region metrics separate

runtime.hardware: Local GPU, recorded by benchmark; never pooled with RTX 4070
runtime.weights: Random shared-backbone weights; architecture latency, not new accuracy inference
runtime.timing: CUDA event and synchronized wall time, randomized arm order per block
runtime.excluded: Disk/image preprocessing, transfers and metric computation
